description: This file defines the Git::SVN::Log package containing functions for processing Subversion logs integrated with Git. It includes methods for parsing commit information, formatting dates, handling pagers, executing commands, and generating log views.

methods.name: cmt_showable
methods.description: Determines if a commit should be shown based on its revision information. Fetches full commit message if truncated.

methods.name: log_use_color
methods.description: Checks if coloring is enabled for logs based on user preferences.

methods.name: git_svn_log_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the git svn log command with appropriate options based on revisions and arguments.

methods.name: config_pager
methods.description: Configures the pager command based on environment and output stream.

methods.name: run_pager
methods.description: Runs the configured pager in a subprocess, redirecting STDIN and STDOUT as needed.

methods.name: format_svn_date
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into SVN date string with timezone offset.

methods.name: parse_git_date
methods.description: Parses a git date string with timezone into a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: set_local_timezone
methods.description: Sets the environment timezone to the specified value.

methods.name: tz_to_s_offset
methods.description: Converts a timezone string (HHMM) into seconds offset.

methods.name: get_author_info
methods.description: Extracts author information from commit data and stores it in a hash.

methods.name: process_commit
methods.description: Decides whether to show a commit based on revision range filters, and processes deferred commits.

methods.name: show_commit
methods.description: Displays a commit in either one-line or normal format.

methods.name: show_commit_changed_paths
methods.description: Prints the changed paths associated with a commit.

methods.name: show_commit_normal
methods.description: Displays detailed commit information including author, date, message, and diff.

methods.name: cmd_show_log
methods.description: Generates and outputs the SVN log, parsing output to handle commit, author, and change info, and invokes display functions.

methods.name: cmd_blame
methods.description: Runs blame command on a file and outputs attribution, including handling for full and short hashes.
